name: The House of Van Helsing
summary: When a member of their family goes missing, the remaining Van Helsing's are brought back together to confront the evil force of a demon witch.

name: The Perfect Line
summary: The Perfect Line is a trivia game that includes questions about from world events, pop culture, sports, science and other topics. Contestants are given a category and then arrange events, items or people order — such as arranging six actors in the order of their worldwide box office gross. Winners are able to create "the perfect line" via that correct order, and try not to be eliminated after every round. The last person standing plays a final round for a chance at $10,000.

name: Las hermanas Guerra
summary: A woman's refusal to join her sister's twisted scheme sparks betrayal and revenge as she tries to reunite with her long-lost daughter in prison.

name: Cold Case: Who Killed JonBenét Ramsey
summary: On December 26, 1996, John and Patsy Ramsey wake up the morning after a loving family Christmas to discover their youngest child, six-year-old JonBenét, is missing, a chilling ransom note left downstairs. Later that day, John Ramsey discovers his daughter's body in the basement, revealing the shocking truth that JonBenét had not been kidnapped, but was instead sexually assaulted and brutally murdered in their own home. The Boulder, Colorado police, who had little practical experience in homicide investigations, quickly cast suspicion on JonBenét's family as the most likely suspects, fanning the flames of media scrutiny and largely one-sided reporting, turning the case into a national obsession. Twenty-eight years later, that obsession — and finger-pointing — hasn't gone away, and the murder of JonBenét Ramsey remains unsolved. From Academy Award nominated director Joe Berlinger, this three-part docuseries investigates the mishandling of the case by law enforcement and the media, ultimately revealing the relatively simple steps that can be taken to finally solve perhaps the most infamous cold case of all time. But will Colorado authorities finally take the necessary steps to bring the vicious killer of JonBenét Ramsey to justice and allow the family to finally have peace of mind?

previousepisode.name: The Truth is Going to Prevail

name: Aaron Rodgers: Enigma
summary: Follow NFL quarterback Aaron Rodgers as he rebounds from an Achilles injury in this sports series chronicling the defining moments of his life and career.

name: The Silent Wife
summary: The amnesiac CEO, Shen Chiyan, mistakes his mute wife, Song Qinian, for a secretary and even uses her as a backup blood donor for his ‘first love.' Unable to speak, Song Qinian tries to help Shen Chiyan recover his memory but fails. The awakened ‘first love' schemes to destroy Song Qinian's family. Faced with a broken love and the loss of her loved ones, the mute wife shockingly finds her voice!

name: Wild Rose
summary: Roosevelt aka 'Rose' is a charismatic hitman with a conscience who comes from a family of assassins that also happen to run a non-profit organization. Behind the non-profit façade is an elite, family-run agency known for taking down high-profile targets. Rose's world is turned upside down when his wife and daughter mysteriously walk out of his life. He suspects foul play and finds himself questioning everything and everyone. As he embarks on a journey to uncover the truth, he starts to unravel a web of secrets that force him to question his identity within his own family. Amidst his personal turmoil, Rose is pulled into the Hollywood underworld of music, fame, sex and murder, when he receives a new assignment: serve as the bodyguard for the world-famous singer, Somaya. But Somaya finds herself in the crosshairs of her own personal security guard, unaware that the man hired to protect her is also contracted to end her life.

name: Rachael Ray's Holidays
summary: Rachael Ray's Holidays the series invites viewers into Rachael's home as she prepares unique dishes perfect for celebrating the holidays with family and friends.

previousepisode.name: Beef and Chorizo Chili with Queso

name: Łowcy skór
summary: The story of a gruesome deal between emergency care workers and morticians in Poland that led to the deaths of several hundred victims.

name: Paris & Nicole: The Encore
summary:
Two decades after exploding onto the scene with their pop-culture-defining reality TV debut, BFFs Paris Hilton and Nicole Richie return to the small screen in an all-new format.  

These reality pioneers are coming back the only way they know how: full of fun, chaos, and epic one-liners! In this new special, Paris and Nicole bring fans up to speed on their lives and friendship in a way that only true legends can. Get ready to fall back in love with this fearsome twosome as they put on an unforgettable performance... Sanasa, sanasa!

name: Lady of the Dunes: Hunting a Cape Cod Killer
summary:
Lady of the Dunes: Hunting a Cape Cod Killer examines the decades-long investigation of the murder of an unknown woman found in the dunes of Provincetown, Mass. Her vicious killing haunted and stymied even the most seasoned members of the town's police department, and surprisingly coincided with a man's pursuit to identify his birth mother. 

In 1974, the idyllic and close-knit community of Provincetown was stunned when the body of an unidentified woman was discovered in a remote area of the dunes. Over the next 50 years, investigators worked tirelessly to identify her, relentless in their pursuit of her killer and her name. The twists and turns of the Lady of the Dunes mystery tell the story of a hidden family, a suspect's violent past and a detective willing to sacrifice her career for answers.

name: Brotherhood of Lions
summary:
An immersive and compelling story of the daily lives and struggles of five young lions in the Black Rock region of Kenya's Masai Mara reserve. Born in 2017, the lions were given names by the Masai people to suit their personalities: Olumina, the lame one, is the most sexually active but has difficulty walking. Olosiadu, the stay-behind, is cautious and often isolates himself. Lorkulup, the tag-along, has a permanent runny nose that hinders him from hunting with his brothers. Orpadan, the hunter, is always in the lead and first to their prey. Oloborr, the sister-killer, is the strongest male and the boss of the group.

Following the lions for the first five years of their lives, this is a gripping and thought-provoking documentary that offers fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals, while highlighting threats such as poaching and habitat loss.

name: A Remarkable Place to Die
summary:
A Remarkable Place To Die follows smart and determined homicide detective Anaís Mallory as she returns to her hometown of Queenstown, New Zealand, assuming the role of lead detective and hoping to unravel the truth behind the deaths of her father and sister.

Mallory has a stellar policing career under way after a secondment to Sydney, but she is forced to confront her strained relationship with her mother and the ghosts of her past, including her ex-fiance Luke, who is now married to her ex-best friend, Maja. 

With a new case to solve every episode, it rapidly becomes apparent that there is plenty hidden beyond the breathtaking scenery of the tourist town. Secrets linger and danger is never too far away. 

As bodies start piling up around the once-safe place, Mallory and her team are thrust into a series of intriguing cases that bring into focus the tragedies that have beset her family. 

Plagued by the suspicion that her ex-fiance might somehow be involved in their deaths, Mallory also realises that her mother may know more than she is willing to reveal.

name: The Scavengers
summary: Set in Ireland in the year 3000, a Scavenger crew are the first (and only) humans to live on earth in a thousand years. Join Arrow (13) along with his sister Starla (15) and best-bud robot ARG, as they navigate the comedic chaos and unexpected dangers of life on future Earth.

name: A More or Less Perfect Union
summary:
A More or Less Perfect Union explores the most contentious issues in American history and today through the lens of the U.S. Constitution. The groundbreaking, three-part public television series tells the story of how the Framers put freedom in writing; how amendment after amendment finally spread freedom to all of "we the people"; and how we still struggle today to preserve the freedoms guaranteed in the Constitution.

Our guide is Judge Douglas H. Ginsburg – a national authority on the Constitution, with 30 years of experience on the Federal Court of Appeals in Washington, D.C. Throughout the series, experts of all stripes – conservative, progressive, and libertarian – debate key issues of liberty: freedom of religion and press, slavery, civil rights, the 2nd Amendment, separation of powers, and more.

name: Как избавиться от невестки за 10 дней
Blood River
summary: Blood River is the realm's most feared assassin guild, jointly run by the Su, Mu, and Xie clans. They can strike royals in court and crush great sects in the wild. When the patriarch is poisoned on a mission, the three clans vie for the top seat. Su Muyu leads the Spider-Shadow unit and shields the dying leader on the road to a cure. He clashes with elder Su Zhe and old friend Su Changhe, and meets master healer Bai Hehuai. After brutal power struggles, Su Changhe becomes new patriarch and Su Muyu heads the Su clan. They launch the "Other Shore Plan" to drag Blood River out of the shadow and forge a new destiny, free from being anyone's blade.

name: Family Planning
summary: A group of people possessing special abilities disguise themselves as a family to survive against heinous criminals. Han Yeong Su is a loving mother with a special ability. Baek Cheol Hui is a father who hides his special ability. He has a timid personality, but he loves his wife, Yeong Su, a lot. Baek Gang Seong is a grandfather who shows an abrupt manner, but he cares for his family a lot. Baek Ji Hun and Baek Ji U are 17-year-old brother and sister. Ji Hun has a warm and gentle personality, while Ji U is picky and sensitive.

name: Churchill at War
summary: This captivating docuseries examines Winston Churchill's pivotal role in World War II and the formative events that made him an ideal leader for the era.

name: Hyper Knife
summary: Jung Se Ok, a formerly successful neurosurgeon who works as a shadow doctor in an underground surgery clinic after being expelled by her mentor, Choi Duk Hee. Soon, both doctors reunite, reigniting a tense and emotional rivalry.

name: Social Savvy Class 101
summary: A high-teen secret romance unfolds when 'Outsider' (an outsider) becomes the manager of the anonymous community app 'Inssa Time' and learns all the secrets of the entire school and joins a group of super popular kids that she desperately wants to get involved with. Kang U Bin is a popular kid among the popular kids and a trainee at a large entertainment agency who is admired by the entire school and is seen as perfect by his classmates. He not only has great visuals but is also good at studying. He seems like a born-to-be superstar who exceeds the webtoon's setting, but he is hiding a secret that no one can find out about. U Bin, who has never been suspected, ends up in an awkward situation because of 'Outssa', whose name is even confusing.

name: The Promise of Growing Up Together
The Darkness
summary: Detective Inspector Hulda Hermannsdóttir is given a shocking new murder case whilst having to work with a new partner, and being in the cusp of early retirement.

name: I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons
Secrets on Maple Street
summary: A trilogy of television movies all set on a street named Maple Street.

previousepisode.name: Murder for Mortgage: Secrets on Maple Street

name: A Deadly Loop
summary: With the wedding day approaching, bride Liu Jingzhi is found dead at home under suspicious circumstances. Her fiancé, wealthy businessman Fang Xuewen, is wrongfully accused of her murder and tragically killed in a hail of bullets. However, a sudden, excruciating pain brings him back to consciousness, only to discover that he is trapped in a time loop. Traveling through time and experiencing infinite rebirths, Fang Xuewen vows to uncover the truth behind his wife's tragic death and rewrite the unjust ending to his own life.

name: Artist of the Year: Masterclass
summary:
Sky Arts' much-loved Artist of the Year franchise has added another brushstroke to its canvas with a brand new series of Masterclasses launching later this year. Artist of the Year: Masterclass will feature live tutorials from a host of talented artists who have taken part in Portrait Artist of the Year or Landscape Artist of the Year, as they demonstrate easy-to learn techniques for budding artists at home. Series judge, Tai-Shan Schierenberg, will also take to his easel to teach masterclasses of his own, showing the nation how he approaches an all-important portrait. 

The new Sky Original series follows the roaring success of Portrait Artist of the Year, the eleventh series of which launched to its biggest audience ever last month. Millions of viewers also tuned in to Portrait Artist of the Week in 2020, which saw celebrities sit live for their portraits during the Covid-19 lockdown. The series went on to break the Guinness World Record last year for the most people painting a portrait at one time as thousands of avid artists painted national treasure, Sir Lenny Henry, to celebrate Portrait Artist of the Year's tenth anniversary.

Artists giving masterclasses alongside Tai-Shan Schierenberg include: Gareth Reid, who was crowned Portrait Artist of the Decade last year, Adebanji Alade, Wendy Barratt, Morag Caister, Finn Campbell-Notman, Phoebe Hicks, Christian Hook, Clare Lord, Sara Reeve and Fujiko Rose. Each masterclass will focus on a different subject or technique to help audiences understand the basics of painting and drawing, with classes covering everything from exploring tone and Alla Prima painting to composing a landscape, botanical flowers and even animal portraiture.

name: I'm A Celebrity... Unpacked
summary: The energetic show will delve into all the camp drama, laughs, and chaos of the jungle and dissect everything that is happening on I'm A Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here!

name: Electric Bloom
summary: Electric Bloom follows three members of a mega-famous pop group, Electric Bloom, as they look back and tell the story of their band and friendship, starting with the day they all met in middle school. The girls go on a journey to becoming the biggest band in the world and the best friends in the universe.

previousepisode.name: How We (Sorta) Got Our First Big Break: Part 2

name: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
summary: Vampirina follows a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire secret, something that's made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school. The series is based on the books written by Anne Marie Pace and illustrated by LeUyen Pham, and inspired by the Disney Jr. animated series "Vampirina" from Chris Nee.

name: Villa Rhodos
summary: Eight young adults gather for a vacation filled with fun and celebration. Each day they are given a challenge, and if they solve it, they get a reward. If they fail, they get punished. Will they get the vacation they've been dreaming of?

name: Gunpowder Siege
summary: Drama detailing one of the most infamous rebellion plots in British history, shattering myths to reveal the largely forgotten, gripping truth behind the Gunpowder Plot.

name: Baban Baban Ban Vampire
summary: When 15-year-old Rihito falls in love, an ancient vampire who craves 18-year-old virgin blood must protect the teen's virginity at all costs.

name: Будьте счастливы
summary: Nadya's world is crumbling: she is childless, her husband leaves for someone else. After a divorce, a woman decides that she has no reason to live anymore, but at the last moment she is saved by an ambulance called by someone unknown. Having come to her senses, Nadya acquires a wonderful gift - to see people destined for each other by fate. She understands that she must connect couples, and a suitable place of work immediately turns up for her - the registry office. But how can you explain to people who don't suspect anything about Nadya's abilities that they should be together?

name: Кордон
summary: Former border guard Sasha Dymov returns to his native village of Kordonka after serving time in prison on a false charge. There is nothing left of his past life - his wife left him for her best friend, and it is impossible to return to law enforcement. His faithful comrade Trofimych comes to the rescue - he takes Dymov under his wing and gets him a job as a car mechanic in his workshop. It would seem that there is no more peaceful occupation. But there is a border nearby, secret smugglers' paths, big money, weapons and criminals dreaming of escaping persecution abroad... Only Sasha Dymov can stop this chaos. In addition to criminal showdowns, the hero will have to find a way out of a love triangle. And there will be mysticism in this story.

name: Ронин
summary: The protagonist, special forces soldier Ivan Doronin, learns of the death of his ex-wife, with whom he hardly communicated and only regularly paid child support for his son Misha. Doronin, who was given leave due to being wounded during the release of hostages, goes to his native village of Medvezhye to pick up the child. But on the spot he learns that his wife has another son, from another man. Both boys live with Doronin's stepfather. Ivan remains in the village to formalize guardianship over Misha. At the same time, the hero has to replace his stepfather, who suddenly fell ill, at work as a postman. While delivering mail around the neighborhood, Ivan often finds himself in difficult situations, where his special forces skills come in handy. So, Doronin will have to take care of the peace of the villagers, become a real father not only to his own child, but also to someone else's child, and also enter into an unequal battle with a high-ranking official for the love of a local beauty.

name: Recipient
summary: High school student Sung Seo Yun feels unwanted by her abusive, dysfunctional family. She longs for the means to escape them all, so she buys lottery tickets. One day she wins the ₩5 billion grand prize, but discovers that minors are ineligible to play or collect the winnings. She turns to an older recent transfer student from a rich family for help.

name: Pour toi Flora
summary: The story of Algonquin siblings, who spent their youth in an Indian Residential School in the 1960s and who are now trying to make peace with this painful past. From the moment they were forcibly removed from the parents by religious authority to the events that led them back to each other forty-five years later, this dramatic mini-series intertwines different times in their lives to tell the story of one Indigenous family's forced estrangement and the path it took to heal.

name: SMEILINGEN – Ein Dorf wie Du und Ich
summary: The small village of Smeilingen lives from the bizarre everyday life of its inhabitants.

previousepisode.name: Folge 6 u. a. mit Nico Stank, Cordula Stratmann und Katrin Bauerfeind

name: Cai Yun Yi San Liu Li Cui
Milkshake! Off We Go!
summary: Jen tries out various modes of travel - from bus to boat, and taxi to train.

name: Hidden in My House
summary: First-hand accounts from survivors sharing skin-crawling and terrifying stories of unknown intruders secretly living in their homes.

name: Piiritys
summary: In 1992, the first murder for hire in Finland's history, by Ilpo Larha, led to a hostage and siege situation that lasted 55 hours after escaping from prison. The story follows these events when DCI Esko Heinonen conducted the negotiation.

name: My Boyfriend Made Me Do It
summary: We meet women who were tricked and forced by partners into committing serious crimes.

name: El Turco
summary: Hasan Balaban, an Ottoman janissary who participated in the 1683 Siege of Vienna, sought refuge in the Italian village of Moena after being severely wounded. There, with the help of the local people, he survives and becomes a hero in the village. This documentary invites viewers to discover the forgotten story of Balaban, whose life was reshaped by the effects of war, and explore his legacy in the village. It also reveals how the Ottoman Empire left its mark in a different geography after the wa

name: Special Forces: Most Daring Missions
summary:
Narrated by Tom Hardy, this thrilling three-part series will examine three deadly and successful missions conducted by British special forces units in different parts of the world.

Throughout the series, the focus is on the men of the British Special Forces who were in the front lines of these operations. We speak to the soldiers on the ground, hearing their first-hand testimonies of what went down over the few tense days and hours of the mission. It is their story, told through a series of intimate interviews, accompanied by action packed drama recon and fascinating archive footage and stills.

High-end drama reconstruction will be an integral element of this series and will help to bring these amazing stories to life. This is full throttle, intense, cinematic and Hollywood style drama but with no scripted dialogue – we will let Tom Hardy and the interviewees do the talking.

name: Bad to Bed
summary: Popular influencer Wan Xiong unexpectedly suffers from insomnia one night, thinking it will pass, only to realize it's the beginning of a physical and mental battle. As he embarks on this journey, he encounters five boys along the way. Can Wan Xiong uncover the reason for his insomnia through their interactions?

name: Revolutions That Changed History
summary: Though history has long lionised its great leaders and early rulers, being an elite wasn't all glory and prosperity. Even the fiercest General and the most enduring Monarch would be confronted by opposition and upheaval. Some learned the hard way that power is far from absolute, and allegiance, always conditional. Revolutions That Changed History exposes the complex truth behind ancient revolutions and revolts, from the epic, action-packed, bloody battlegrounds to the intimate exchanges between confidants that were powerful enough to turn tides. Episodes include Wat Tyler's Rebellion (Peasant's Revolt), Boudica's Revolt, French Revolution, Third Servile War, American Revolution and Decembrist Revolt.

name: Zlociny Velké Prahy
summary: The Inspector Hynek Budik as been assigned chief of police in the area on the outskirts of Prague, With detectives Martin Novacek an inexperienced rookie and the inspector Havlik will seek to solve difficult cases of murder.

name: В тени больших чисел
summary: A serial killer nicknamed "The Trucker" is on the loose in the city. He kills young women near intercity highways, takes off their shoes and covers their faces with their hair. Captain Anastasia Olkhovskaya is at a dead end - three bodies already, and no witnesses or evidence. Then a man appears who claims to know where and when the next murder will be committed.

name: Битва стартапов
summary: After the All-Russian casting, 20 young entrepreneurs were selected to present their solutions to the jury. Ahead of the heroes are a meeting with developers and six weeks of work on the startup

name: Dans les bottes de Lucky Luke
summary: Relentless sheriffs, trigger-happy gunslingers, steadfast saloon owners and cocky cowboys are all found in the "Lucky Luke" albums, which have influenced entire generations of comic readers. For the three-part series "In the footsteps of Lucky Luke", the French comic author Jul traveled to the USA to trace the role models of the familiar comic characters.

name: GTO in Taiwan
summary: With more Taiwanese students studying at Japanese universities in recent years, Japanese teachers need to better understand these students. When Onizuka is invited for a one-week teaching exchange program at a Taiwanese high school, he is eager for the experience and takes his friend Ryuuji with him. On their first day there, Onizuka and Ryuuji meet Saejima, a local legend.

name: AARO: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office
summary: A special investigative unit tackles everything from mysterious disappearances and shadowy figures to eerie supernatural phenomena.

name: Three Meals a Day Light
summary:
In the scorching heat of this summer, a love-filled dining table returns!

To celebrate its 10th anniversary, Three Meals a Day, a beloved show known for traveling across the country, is back—fresher and lighter than ever! Chef Cha Seung-won, who can whip up a meal anywhere, and the ever-resourceful handyman Yoo Hai-jin reunite for this cozy series. Where will their new summer "Three Meals House" be this time? The duo's easygoing summer days unfold in a way that will keep you watching.

A warm story of shared meals, spanning mountains and seas.

name: No Home
summary: Haejoon Goh, who ran from home, and Eunyung Baek, the problem child who lives in a tent. These two, who met under terrible circumstances, are forced to live together in an abandoned dormitory. This is a story of difficult growth between two people who hate both the dorm and each other.

name: Sorry Not Sorry
summary: Dumped overnight, Ji Song Yi is left burdened by the difficulties of single life, part-time jobs, and paying off her newlywed home loan. She keeps up the ruse of being a happily married woman to save herself from being estranged from the married townswomen.

name: Buddy Boy
summary:
Yuho, an 18-year-old boy who took refuge in a quiet rural village due to his parents' bankruptcy.
Even at a glance, Yuho exudes the image of a boy who grew up only in the city.
While walking along the valley path and meditating, he spots a girl (Lina) and a boy (Jin Goo) who appear to be around the same age splashing in the water.
Yuho sees beauty and a strange excitement for the first time in his life as he sees their sparkling figures together with Yunseul in the valley...

name: Way Back Love
summary: The Grim Reaper appears as the person you love the most before you die. In front of 24-year-old Hee Wan who had no will to carry on and lived as a social outcast, her childhood friend as well as her first love Ram Woo appears as a Grim Reaper and tells her she will die in a week. Hee Wan and Ram Woo are forced to spend a week together. Throughout their time together, they rediscover the meaning of life and reconnect with what truly matters.

name: The Long River
summary: After the disastrous flood in the 15th year of young Emperor Kang Xi, he opens an imperial examination to find water-control talents and get a 24-year-old genius Chen Huang. Chen cooperates with Jin Fu, a official in the same camp, to control water for more than fifty years.

name: Judi Love's Culinary Cruise
summary: Judi Love embarks on a culinary adventure aboard a luxury yacht, visiting fabulous locations and finding out all about local heritage and traditions, taking in the culture and incredible produce.

name: Chess Masters: The Endgame
summary: Sue Perkins hosts this high-stakes chess contest, following 12 rising stars of the UK's booming chess community as they battle it out via a gauntlet of brain-bending puzzles and nail-biting eliminators to be crowned champion.

name: Wild Cherry
summary:
Meet Lorna, a self-made, successful black businesswoman from South London who has worked hard to be where she is – and best friend Juliet, a woman born into the privileged gated community they both call home. Daughters Grace and Allegra are BFFs and live a life other teenagers can only dream of. A safe haven for the super-rich and their little darlings, Richford Estate is a place where bad things never happen…

Until, that is, Grace and Allegra are implicated in a shocking scandal at their exclusive private school and Juliet and Lorna are forced to take sides, pushing their friendship to breaking point. As toxic secrets and lies ripple through the idyllic town, cracks within the community threaten to reveal the elitist ugliness and betrayal beneath.

previousepisode.name: I Don't Put Anything Past Teenage Girls

name: De bedste år
summary: Exploring how people often have young children while their career, job, and finances demand the most from them. And how it can sometimes feel impossible to keep up and have enough energy for life, all while it seems like everyone around you has figured life out much better than you.

name: The Nine to Five with Stacey Dooley
summary: Stacey takes five 16-18-year-olds into industries crying out for young workers to give them the ultimate work experience.

name: Velkommen til frontlinjen
summary: Denmark has sent over 30,000 soldiers to war over the last 30 years. In this series, they tell of the loss of innocence, about the courage and about the consequences it has had for us and for those we fought.

name: Invasion: The Normans
summary: Invasion: The Normans explores the 12th Century Norman invasion of Ireland, a real-life Game of Thrones that changed the history of Europe forever.

name: The Parasocial Social Club
summary: The Parasocial Social Club - ‘where you know everything about us and we know nothing about you'. Jenny and Kevin are two millennial stand-up comedians clumsily trying to get through life.

name: Sue Perkins' Big Adventure: Paris to Istanbul
summary: Sue Perkins embarks on an adventure along the route of the Orient Express, tracing the path through the heart of Europe, exploring vibrant cultures and stunning landscapes, and meeting the people who give each city its unique identity.

name: The Jury: Death on the Staircase
summary: This groundbreaking series follows a re-enactment of a real manslaughter case, presented word-for-word with actors, before a new jury of 12 everyday Australians.

name: Enfermeras
summary: Through the view of nurse María Clara Gonzales, we discover the world of a Latin American university hospital.

name: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
summary: A festive special of Ainsley's show.

name: The Price Is Right Million Dollar Spectacular
summary: The Price is Right $1,000,000 Spectacular is a special primetime version of The Price is Right where in addition to the usual (contestants try to know their prices to win big prizes), they also try to win $1,000,000.

name: Sablja
summary: Belgrade, 2003. When Serbian Prime Minister Zoran Djindjic is assassinated, the country plunges into chaos, and the authorities' response is to introduce a state of emergency. A turning point in recent Serbian history through the perspective of a journalist, a police officer, and a criminal.

name: Baddies Midwest
summary: The Baddies are back - this time bringing it to the Midwest!

name: Girls of Oslo
summary: Experience the captivating world of Norway's most influential people like never before!

name: Back to 1995
summary: Zhang Dabao is a middle-aged man who has lost confidence in life after facing numerous setbacks. When he unexpectedly travels back to 1995 and meets his 22-year-old self, the two embark on a journey filled with challenges that inspire them to join forces. Together, they seek to reconcile past regrets and forge a new beginning in their lives.

name: Crows
summary: Harumichi Bouya is the new transfer student coming to Suzuran High School, nicknamed the "School of Crows" because of the jet-black school outfit & the fact that all of the students are hated delinquents. Harumichi quickly becomes friends with Yasuo Yasuda, a small & weak boy who is easily preyed upon by the large Akutsu. Though Harumichi has no interest in the existing gang wars in Suzuran to determine who can lead the school as a unified group, a feat that has never been done in the history of the school, he still gets involved when his beastly power in fighting attracts the attention of Hideto Bandou, who leads a division of a motorcycle gang called The Front of Armament.

name: Saved by His Tender Love
summary: When Ye Wan Chu was desperate, she followed Mr. Mu back home. Unexpectedly, four years later, she would become Mr. Mu's sweetheart.

name: The WONDERfools
summary: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

previousepisode.name: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 2

name: La Liberación
summary: Three women join forces to prevent a sexual harassment complaint against a renowned movie director from coming to light. This controversial mission will take them to the doors of a feminist group named La Aldea, which will take them on an inward journey to heal their patriarchal wounds.

name: The Artist
summary: In the twilight of the Gilded Age, an ensemble of the era's celebrities, including Thomas Edison, Edgar Degas and Evelyn Nesbit meet for a gathering at the house of an eccentric and failing tycoon, which turns deadly.

name: City Sessions
summary: City Sessions is a new series from Amazon Music that brings together some of the biggest names in music for a series of intimate performances. Taking place at iconic venues around the globe, the series will feature artists from across genres performing new music and discussing their craft with their fans.

name: The Big Trip
summary:
Eight stars of screen, sport and comedy embark on the Great Aussie Road Trip with a twist in the brand-new adventure series, The Big Trip, premiering 8.30pm, Wednesday 13 November on Channel 7 and 7plus.

Hosted by comedian Dave "Thorno" Thornton, The Big Trip sees four pairs of celebrity friends set out on an epic adventure across the Australian outback, with just two weeks to make it from the Great Australian Bight to Sydney's Harbour Bridge.

The original format turns road tripping into a competitive sport, with the celebs facing high-stakes challenges at every turn, as they compete for the chance to gift $300,000 of hybrid and EV cars to some lucky fans.

What starts as a love letter to Australia and its larrikin locals, twists and turns through white-knuckle, nail-biting moments to hilarious shenanigans, as alliances form, betrayals brew and scandals erupt with teams going to any lengths to claim victory.

name: The Woohoos!
summary:
The gentle, warm and character-driven series aims to delight and entertain young children. Each episode brings an exciting "Ooo" moment, a new discovery that needs explaining, and then when the characters find the answer they say "Woohoo."

Kids can "Ooo" and "Woohoo" while watching their new friends pack their day full of adventure, making each other laugh as they all explore the Woohoos homeland of Wise Island together. The little Woohoos discover dancing bees, things that float and things that don't and how you find your way, even without a map.

name: Rubble's Big Builds
summary: Take a trip around the world to learn about some of the biggest construction projects on the planet.

name: Die Spaltung der Welt: 1939-1962
summary: From the Second World War to the 1960s, when the world was divided into East and West, this series traces the lives of six real people, including the German engineer Wernher von Braun, who rose from Nazi ranks to eventually work for NASA, the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev and the future Prime Minister of Israel Golda Meir.

name: I Have a Crush at Work
summary: Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi aren't just any coworkers—they totally have the hots for each other. His helpful yet humble attitude makes her giddy, and her cuteness leaves him grinning like a fool. Problem is, they're trying to keep their new relationship under wraps to avoid making things awkward at work. But seeing how they can't keep their hands off each other, they run the risk of spilling their little secret with each passing day at the office.

previousepisode.name: I Have a Crush at Work

name: 30 שקל לשעה
summary: Three hard workers cleaning women who work in a man-power company get fired. In order to survive in the big city they decide to offer their service to their old customers directly.

name: Boy Culture: Generation X
summary: Male escort X is up against a younger generation who've gained a competitive edge.

name: Damaged
summary: Homophobia, anxiety & fear play out in post marriage equality Australia.

name: Atout 5
summary: The adventures of five friends who attend a boarding school and dream of becoming a band.

name: Dushi Gu Xian Yi
summary: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

name: Love Behind the Mask
summary: Si Yichen, son of King Zishang, loses his entire family in a massacre on his wedding day. To seek revenge, he assumes the identity of Mu Han and gains the trust of the Eldest Princess. Meanwhile, his fiancée, Hang Anning, believing him to be dead, infiltrates the palace by swapping faces with the princess. Under the same roof, their hidden identities lead to unexpected emotions, love and vengeance become inseparable.

name: The Song Inquisitor
summary: Set during the Southern Song Dynasty, this story follows Song Ci, a judicial officer, who encounters danger while on an inspection tour. By a twist of fate, he meets Southern Opera performers Zhao Zhiting and Wang Ling, and dancer He Wenning. Despite their differences, the four join forces, solving four murder cases through investigation, interrogation, and forensic analysis, bringing justice to the deceased and fairness to the living.

name: After a Flash Marriage, I Became a Stepmother
The Colosseum with Dan Snow
summary: The Colosseum is the legendary symbol of ancient Rome. Dan Snow guides us through Rome's underground, revealing caverns where slaves extracted materials, including the groundbreaking Roman concrete, enabling its 10-year construction.

name: The Road Trip
summary:
The Road Trip is a witty, contemporary, emotionally complex romantic comedy about giving love another shot. Can someone be the right person, just at the wrong time? And is there ever a future in returning to a past love?

Addie and her sister are on a road trip to a friend's wedding in Spain when they are forced to share the ride with Addie's ex Dylan, his irrepressible best friend Marcus, and complete stranger Rodney. With nowhere to hide but a creaky campervan, the group must confront their buried history as secrets and revelations cause many a bump in the road.

name: The Body
summary: This brand-new true-crime anthology explores murder stories that began with bodies discovered in unusual public or private spaces – leading to gripping investigations, with first-hand accounts from detectives and chilling archive and evidence.

name: The Secret Genius of Plants
summary: The wonderful world of plants and their vital role in our shared planet. See them as never before - and marvel at their remarkable abilities to flourish, adapt and survive.

name: Extreme Road Ragers
summary: Ride along for an eye-opening journey as Extreme Road Ragers delves into the lives of some of the country's most intense drivers. With insights from family, friends, and experts, will they find a way to transform their behavior before it spirals out of control?

name: NWA: Total Nonstop Action
summary: NWA-TNA procured weekly pay-per-view events every Wednesday night for $9.95.

name: TNA One Night Only
summary: One Night Only was a series of professional wrestling events held by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) launched in April 2013.

name: Otherworldly Munchkin
summary: 16-year-old Yukito Kirihara lives with his 14-year-old sister Sana, who he treasures more than anyone else. But when an ogre shows up outside of his window looking for Sana (a shocking event in its own right), Yukito leaps to save her—and is killed. He's offered the promise of reincarnation by a mysterious woman, who gives him a character sheet in a mysterious book. But when Yukito sees Sana in there, too, he sets off to find her, and save them both—even if he only has 1 hp with which to do it!

name: Limbs in the Loch: Catching a Killer
summary:
In December 1999, a grim discovery is made during a routine police diving exercise in the bitterly cold waters of Loch Lomond.

Divers spot submerged bin bags, expecting them to be filled with rubbish - but upon closer inspection they instead find human limbs. Eight days later another bag - containing a head - is found washed up 60 miles away on Barassie Beach, Ayrshire.

This series tells the inside story of the investigation into a crime which shocked the country. Senior police officers, including detectives at the heart of the inquiry, experts and crime journalists give their insights into a horrific murder and the pursuit of justice.

name: Aindham Vedham
summary: Anu embarks on a journey to Varanasi for her mother's last rites. En route, she's entrusted with an ancient relic by a stranger, destined for a Tamil Nadu priest, which may unveil the secrets of the elusive Fifth Veda

name: Mountains
summary: Zhang Beichen, the mountain wanderer; Duan Siyan, a martial arts master; Wei Ling'er, the descendant of the ghost doctor, and Ma Tianhong from the north embark on a journey to uncover the truth behind the Golden Crow Transformation. Along the way, they encounter various strange events, solving each mystery as they go. Through these bizarre occurrences, they witness the greed, anger, ignorance, and hatred in the world, while also experiencing the most precious human emotions

name: Zeit Verbrechen
summary: In four films, four outstanding directors explore the limits and possibilities of the (true) crime genre. Each inspired by an episode of the podcast "Zeit Verbrechen", which is one of the most listened to and successful podcasts in Germany with around five million streams a month, Helene Hegemann, Faraz Shariat, Mariko Minoguchi and Jan Bonny direct four radical and extraordinary crime films that go beyond genre conventions.

name: Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders
summary:
Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders documents the real-time New York State Police cold case investigation into the two unidentified victims of serial killer Joel Rifkin, the most prolific serial killer in New York State history.

Through rare police access and several never-before-seen interviews, including the first interview with Rifkin in over a decade, cameras follow investigators as this 30-year-old serial killer case is reignited by TV producer Peter Reiss through his relationship with Joel Rifkin.

name: All Aboard! Scotland's Poshest Train
summary: From picturesque scenery and rich history to sumptuous spa rooms and culinary artistry, Alan Cumming revels in the Royal Scotsman's splendour on an opulent odyssey through the heart of Scotland.

name: Shoot to Kill: Terror on the Tube
summary: Documentary featuring previously unheard testimony, exploring the manhunt following the London bombings of 2005, and the shooting of innocent electrician Jean Charles de Menezes by armed police

name: Cribbins
summary: A mix of quickfire comedy sketches and songs.

name: Landslagspausen
summary: Football genius Erling Braut Haaland is experiencing the toughest opposition of his career before the European Championship qualifiers: Norwegian expectations.

name: Peak TV
summary: Welcome to Peak TV – six comedians with an absurd sense of humor take you into situations and universes you never knew you wanted to visit.

name: Viggo Venn følger klovnedrømmen
summary: Welcome to Viggo Venn's world! Join Viggo on a journey around the world to follow his clown dream. If only he knew what it was.

name: Drømmerommet
summary: Margrethe brings in carpenter Ola to create the coolest children's rooms, without buying anything new.

name: Valpedrømmen
summary: Puppies are mischievous and disobedient, but they are also cuddly and incredibly cute! Maren meets puppies and new puppy owners, and teaches them to become children's best friends.

name: Langrennsgutta
summary: The elite cross-country boys' team is topped with the best of the best. They compete almost more against each other than against other nations. In this series you get an exclusive insight into their everyday lives.

name: Quisling
summary: At the end of the war, Vidkun Quisling is arrested and put on trial. Maria, Quisling's wife, tries to save him from the death penalty, while the church's sent priest, Peder Olsen, tries to save his soul.

name: Maníaco do Parque: A História Não Contada
summary: Francisco de Assis Pereira's crimes are revisited from the perspective of the victims, new reports from investigators and unpublished audio recordings from one of Brazil's most infamous serial killers, known as the Park Maniac.

name: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
summary: The story of immigrants who founded first Hollywood studios.

name: Родня
summary: Kinfolk is a new musical show in which close relatives of very famous stars of our pop show sing. 100 players from all over the country will gather in a large studio and try not only to become famous by telling the audience about themselves, but also to earn money, because in the common bank there is one and a half million rubles. You just need to guess whose brother, godfather or matchmaker is performing so famously on stage in front of them.

name: Отдел раскрытых дел
summary: Detectives Shvetsov and Yakushev, in the company of their partners, are struggling to solve already solved cases

name: Moresnet
summary: Moresnet is a storied town and the setting for a European mystery thriller of the same name about a group of friends who dig up a time capsule buried two decades earlier, only to find their names listed inside with dates marked for their death.

name: Token White Friends
summary: In Token White Friends when a black couple adopts a white child, they reach out to three estranged white college friends to be part of their village.

name: Oh Nah!
summary:
Oh Nah! is billed as an "absurdist local anthology series" that explores the cultural roots of Māori mythology and contemporary life.

A wild series of buzzy scenarios featuring Kiwi viral sensations Jimi Jackson, Uncle Tics, Uce Gang, Torrell Tafa, Nepia Takuira-Mita and JP.

name: Check in Hanyang
summary: A drama about Yongcheonru, the largest guest inn of Joseon, with the unspoken value 'guests are kings', and the Joseon flower youths who joined the company as educational envoys who were hired by the government office to do small things.

name: Разговор с Антоном Остерниковым
summary: This is just a conversation in which Anton Konstantinovich communicates with guests about their lives.

name: Ireland's Unidentified Bodies
summary: It is unknown exactly how many unidentified remains lie in mortuaries, forensic labs and graveyards across Ireland. These are bodies or bones that have been found on beaches, in fishermen's nets, in rivers and woodland. And no one knows who they are. This four-part series follows the efforts of Gardaí and Forensic Scientists as they try to solve the mystery of a body without a name.

name: Работа над ошибками
summary:
Boris Shershenev is a VGIK graduate, a stubborn Siberian, a talented director, and a real womanizer. His thesis short film won a prize at Cannes, and Goskino commissioned him to direct a full-length film.

The lead role in Boris's short film was played by Zina, an acting student with whom Boris is having an affair. Zina hopes to also star in the feature film. But Boris finds another actress. Insulted, Zina decides to take revenge on Boris—she accuses him of rape.

name: Who Is She
summary: A romantic music coming-of-age drama about grandmother Oh Mal Soon, who turns into a 20-year-old Oh Doo Ri overnight and enjoys her shining prime once again.

previousepisode.name: A Flower That Never Fully Bloomed

name: Uzak Şehir
summary: Alya Albora arrives in the Albora lands of Mardin from Canada with her late husband's body and her five-year-old son, fulfilling his final wish. However, there is no return or escape from Albora. Cihan Albora, the head of the Albora family, may not remain indifferent to Alya's struggles, but he refuses to let her leave with her child. As Alya faces the dark past, hidden secrets, and the realities of the region, she finds herself in a fierce battle with her husband's family.

name: A.Ş.K
summary: Azra and Kerem is a couple who meets Sebnem, however Sebnem doesn't know they're together. Sebnem has cancer, the doctor said she will die soon. Sebnem is in love with Kerem. Kerem and Azra decides to get Kerem in a relationship with Sebnem.

name: Martin Scorsese Presents: The Saints
summary: Explores the lives and sacrifices of historical saints like Joan of Arc, Francis of Assisi, John the Baptist, Thomas Becket, Mary Magdalene, Moses the Black, Sebastian, and Maximillian Kolbe, highlighting their acts.

name: Pretty Boy
summary: This drama tells the story of Qing Cai (played by Darren Chen), the son of the late king, who lives anonymously in a small town to stay away from political disputes in the court. When his adoptive father Han Zhong is in danger, he has to disguise himself as a woman to sneak into Mingyi Villa, which only recruits female disciples. He meets the Mo Sect orphan Gan Po (played by Zheng Hehuizi) who came to seek revenge, as well as Wang Yishao (played by Zhu Zanjin), Han Aizhen (played by Wang Zijia), Gao Yin (played by Moe Jiang), Hu Jiao (played by Yin Qixi), and others with various identities and motives. As Qing Cai lands himself in ridiculously comical situations as he tries to hide his identity, he also develops feelings for Gan Pu. The two bickering friends Qing Cai and Gan Pu gradually fall in love with each other, but in the face of their true identities, they drift apart. When Gan Pu finally works out her conflicted feelings, she joins hands with Qing Cai to fight against the enemy.

name: The Double
summary: When Wu Baohui, a poor girl, got a sudden windfall of a huge fortune, she became Li Ziyu, a rich heiress. But before she knew it, she found herself involved in the rich's power struggle...

name: Secret Love
summary: When An was only eleven, he and his parents were in an accident that took their lives but spared An. He was then adopted by Gu Hao Wei, a CEO and friend of his parents. An was then living under the same roof as his crush Jin. Sometime after An and Jin overheard an argument over An inheriting the company, Jin began to ignore him and chose to go to school in America. Sure he knew the reason, An felt guilty. Years later, Jin returns and attends the same university as An. Still at odds and fighting all the time, Jin's jealousy drives him to use force with An, who he's long been in love with. Knowing the truth—that his father had been responsible for An's childhood accident—Jin has avoided facing him.

name: Snoop Dogg's Fatherhood: Cori and Wayne's Story
summary: Snoop Dogg's Fatherhood: Cori and Wayne's Story follows Cori Broadus, entrepreneur and daughter of globally recognized superstar Snoop Dogg, and her fiancé, Wayne Duece, as they plan the wedding of the century. However, with four months to plan, a growing guest list and pending to-do's before their I do's, life does not always go as planned. Cori has a solid support system with Wayne, dad Papa Snoop, mom "Boss Lady" Shante, brothers Corde and Cordell and bestie bridesmaids by her side to get through the stress of wedding preparations. After an epic bachelorette celebration, Cori and Wayne's picture-perfect wedding crumbles when Cori's gown isn't what she envisions, Wayne and his groomsmen get off on the wrong foot with a conflict over "kicks" and a pre-marital counseling session reveals some underlying issues and ultimatums that turns their lives upside down. As Cori and Wayne are left to manage these relationship tensions, all while facing public backlash over their union, it proves to be too much. After a sudden life-threatening health scare, Cori must come to terms with her own private health struggles, leaving the Broadus crew to focus on what's most important … family.

name: Hotel Inhumans
summary: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one's identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

name: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
summary: A new dark h̶e̶r̶o̶ healer is born! He's no shadow doctor. He's a shadow healer who cures, comforts, and even rights the wrongs of the world...? "You haven't done anything lately. To be honest, we don't need you anymore." When a young healer named Zenos is deemed "useless" by the party of adventurers, he is banished from the group with a single gold coin as severance pay. Born in the slums, Zenos practices self-taught healing magic without a healer's license. As he wanders the streets with nowhere to go, he comes across Lily, an elf girl who's on the verge of dying from a wound to her stomach. "Don't worry, it's not that bad. You'll be fine." "Huh? It doesn't hurt and the wound is gone! What did you do?!" A quietly run clinic in an abandoned town at the very edge of the slums sets the stage for the fantastic tale of a brilliant unlicensed healer who has no idea just how powerful he truly is.

name: Семья по правилам и без
summary: The story of one of the country's most influential families.

name: Doctor's Mine
summary: To get out of some drama, medical student Mind claims to be the 'boyfriend' of engineering senior Night. Unexpectedly, this ends up coming true. Meanwhile, more drama comes from the one night stand between intern Kan and engineering student Per, as well as childhood friends Turn and Klah. Three groups of students in science, seniors versus juniors, who will win whose heart?

name: TNA PPV
summary: Binge on classic and current IMPACT Wrestling pay-per-views, dating all the way back to the first three-hour extravaganza in 2004!

name: Namib
summary: After being fired for her past mistakes, former entertainment company CEO Kang Soo-hyun is offered a severance package to buy out her longtime trainee, Yoo Jin-woo. Soo-hyun decides to train Jin-woo well and sell him to another company so that she can buy a factory for her disabled child. At first, she only thinks of her own child and tries to make Jin-woo successful, but as time goes by, she helps him sincerely.

name: Karena and Kasey's Kitchen Diplomacy
summary: They took MasterChef by storm, now Karena and Kasey are taking their cooking skills on a global world tour! Made with support from NZ On Air.

name: When Fate Plays Matchmaker
summary: Zhao Shuangshuang, owner of a matchmaking agency, possesses the "Matchmaker's Eyes," a gift that allows her to see the "red strings of fate" connecting destined lovers. As a result, she becomes the top matchmaker in Lin'an City. Her biggest dream is to unite 81 couples and find her own destined love. Zhao crosses paths with Cheng Yin, a young Taoist who has sworn to destroy all matches made by "evil matchmakers" after his senior brother's tragic death. The two clash at every turn, challenging each other on every match they make. Over time, Cheng's feelings for Zhao grow without him even realizing—until her "first love," Cao Sui, returns. But the biggest crisis in their relationship soon follows, as Cheng discovers that Zhao might be connected to his brother's death. As they unravel the past, they eventually find happiness together, running the matchmaking agency side by side.

name: Ты заплатишь за всё
summary: Anna's home was always a full cup: a caring and well-off husband, obedient children. There was one problem - her sister was seriously ill. After a course of treatment, the girl was supposed to get better, but she suddenly died because of the very drug that was associated with hope for recovery. Anna decides to punish those responsible for her sister's death and goes to court.

name: Frågan är fri
summary: Some of the country's biggest profiles are interviewed by reporters on the autism spectrum or with intellectual disabilities. Unfiltered questions get a unique answer.

name: Stureplansmorden
summary: December 4, 1994 has been called the night when Stockholm's nightlife lost its innocence. At 5 o'clock in the morning, someone with an automatic weapon shoots straight into the entrance of the Sturecompagniet nightclub in central Stockholm. Four young people die and around 20 are seriously injured. The perpetrators, who were previously denied entry to the club, have come back for revenge. This year marks 30 years since the brutal shooting. Victims, witnesses, police, media and relatives talk about the event that left an indelible mark. What happened then?

name: Overstepping
summary: Overstepping is set after a financial crisis, where a 50-something wild child moves in with her estranged 20-something stepdaughter, giving them a chance to rebuild their rocky relationship and lean on each other as they tackle life and love from two different sides of the generation gap.

name: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour
summary: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour follows the multi-platinum Take That star to explore another passion of his… discovering new food and wine!

name: Noche de Estrellas
summary:
Noche de Estrellas promises an unforgettable evening filled with exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes glimpses, stunning fashion moments, and more. As The Biggest Night in Latin Music™ celebrates its 25th anniversary, this year's pre-show will immerse audiences in the vibrant atmosphere of Latin music. Viewers will witness the first winners of the night and enjoy a special package highlighting the nominees for the Best New Artist category through the Best New Artist Showcase. 

Additionally, this year's show will reminisce with artists about their first performances and the most emblematic moments from the last 25 years of the Latin GRAMMYs. This retrospective will provide a unique perspective on the evolution and impact of this prestigious event within the Latin music industry, making it a night to remember for fans and artists alike.

previousepisode.name: 2025 Premio Lo Nuestro Noche de Estrellas

name: Murder Down Under: Bodies in the Barrels
summary: Snowtown, now synonymous with the worst serial killings in Australia's history – a look into the case and the man behind the murders with Peter Overton and Dimity Clancey.

name: EY Entrepreneur of the Year Awards
summary: Highlights from the EY Entrepreneur of the Year Ireland Gala Awards.

previousepisode.name: EY Entrepreneur of the Year Awards 2025

name: Holding
summary: A young woman who holds a freediving world record and her uphill battle against her siblings and the mafia to take over the management of one of the country's largest conglomerates.

name: WWE NXT Premium Live Events
summary: This is a list of WWE NXT pay-per-view and livestreaming supercards, detailing all professional wrestling cards promoted by the American promotion WWE on pay-per-view (PPV) and available via livestreaming on services such as the WWE Network. Due to the American version of the WWE Network merging under Peacock, and with the WWE Network still available in most international markets, as well as less focus being given to traditional PPV channels, in 2022, the company began using the term "Premium Live Event" to refer to their events airing on PPV and the livestreaming services. The terminology "TakeOver" was dropped in December of 2021 as the NXT brand transformed.

name: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
summary: In the middle of a ball, Scarlet's fiancé, Kyle, suddenly calls off their engagement. She's falsely accused of being a bully and people unfairly call her a "Villainess." The aristocrats and noble families all denounce her. For years, she had to put up with his abuse and idiocy, but she can't take anymore of it! At her wit's end, she asks for one last favor; to give him a good fist in the face. So begins Scarlet's story of revenge against Kyle and his cronies! A fantasy about an elegant yet rebellious fighter, who doesn't let anyone take advantage of her!!

previousepisode.name: May I Ask for One Final Thing?

name: Immigration: How British Politics Failed
summary: Uncovering who and what made immigration unignorable and brought politics to crisis. Blair, Cameron, Farage, migrant activists and government and media insiders go on record.

name: Killed Without a Trace
summary:
Killed Without a Trace explores the huge task facing police forces and prosecutors across the UK as they try to get justice for families and prove a murder has happened without that vital piece of evidence – the body.

British actress Joanna Scanlan explores these remarkable and unconventional investigations, uncovering the lengths detectives must go to prove a murder has occurred. Joanna also reveals the heart-rending stories of families who, despite seeing a killer brought to justice, never had the chance to lay their loved ones to rest and are still searching for closure all these years later.

This Crime + Investigation commission includes interviews from detectives leading the investigations, prosecutors, experts who helped to establish ‘no proof of life' and firsthand testimonies from friends and family.

name: It's a Scouse Life
summary: Reality show following the glamorous lives of a group of young metropolitan Merseysiders as they work hard and play hard in one of Europe's liveliest cities: Liverpool.

name: Tsunami 2004: The Day the Wave Hit
summary: Charting the moment by moment eruption of one of the biggest disasters in natural history, Tsunami 2004: The Day the Wave Hit recounts the extraordinary stories of human determination against the odds.

name: Nissesvingen
summary: In Nissesvingen, Santa Claus is on the verge of death, and their only hope for survival is a magical medallion that the Santa Council finds on the internet. Judas, Santa Claus' second-in-command, must send out an expedition to retrieve the magical medallion from a mail-order shop at a deserted gas station. The expedition, consisting of the three completely useless elves Rolf, Trond and Jerry, has a very dangerous journey ahead of them, and only they can save Santa Claus and save Christmas.

previousepisode.name: Om du føler deg som nisse, er du nisse

name: Living with Lucy
summary: Host Lucy Kennedy meets celebrities inside their own homes to share open and candid conversations with them about their life and other topics.

name: The Big Interview
summary: Claire Brock hosts an interview with a famous person.

name: Dominant Yakuza and Wimpy Corporate Slave
summary: A yakuza with a strong sense of justice and a Taiwanese social worker on a business trip to Japan—two worlds collide in a love that transcends nationalities and identities.

name: The Reserve
summary: The inspiring story of Balule, a private nature reserve in South Africa, that is triumphing against the odds in a relentless battle to save its rhino population.

name: Avlogga
summary: We scroll and scroll and scroll. So do Mike and Sven, until they decide to live a whole year without a phone. Smart!

name: Explore TV
summary: Explore TV is an experiential travel series showcasing places to visit and explore discovering things through the eyes of the host and presenters. It was created out of a passion for travel and exploring this amazing planet we live on. The series is intentionally designed to reveal new and interesting things away from the main stream tourism attractions allowing an insight into the culture, attractions, people and food of the countries we visit.

name: The Summit
summary:
The Summit sees 14 strangers from all walks of life face the daunting challenge of climbing a mountain in the rugged Alps of New Zealand's south island. They will also face the ultimate test of strategy and resilience as they compete for a share of a potential £200,000 cash prize.

With 2 weeks to reach the summit, and an equal share of the prize fund in their backpacks, the contestants will have to navigate treacherous terrain, wild conditions and overcome challenges – set by the mysterious Mountain's Keeper – that block their path to the peak. But it isn't just a test of physical strength; strategy plays a crucial role, as the cast will also have to eliminate their competitors along the way. Who will forge alliances? Who will betray? And ultimately who will have what it takes to conquer the mountain and claim the prize?

name: Task
summary: Task is set in the working class suburbs outside of Philadelphia and follows an FBI agent as he heads a Task Force to put an end to a string of drug-house robberies led by an unsuspecting family man.

name: Молодая кровь
summary:
"Molodaya krov'" is a reality show about what is hidden behind the bright wrapper of the life of famous performers and how difficult it is to become a real star and what trials await newcomers on the path to fame.
BlackStar Inc. and STS LOVE held an all-Russian casting of future label artists. Out of 2.5 thousand people, after 2 stages of casting, 6 people were selected. They will face difficult tests for a month, as well as classes with the best specialists in the country's music industry. During this period, they will have to record at least 1 track, which they will present at the final reporting concert.
Who will join the big BlackStar Inc. family and receive a contract with one of the most successful production centers in the country? Who will become the new black star?

name: Matki Pingwinów
summary: When her seven-year-old son moves to a new school, an MMA fighter realizes that her toughest fight won't be in the octagon, but in parenthood.

name: Hello Mello
summary: Sveriges mest lovande unga artister tävlar med nyskriven musik från några av Sveriges mest kända låtskrivare. 25 låtar. 5 deltävlingar. En final. Vem vinner årets Hello Mello? Programledare är Malin Olsson och Eric Saade.

name: Invisible Us
summary: In 2024, an unidentified young man causes a heinous crime in Shibuya, Tokyo. Nakagawa Aoi, a weekly magazine writer, suspects that the perpetrator of the crime might be a former high school classmate. This leads her to reconnect with old friends she had lost touch with. While reflecting on her high school days, she pursues the truth behind the crime.

name: Echoes of the Past
summary: Accused of his sister's murder, Yehia is fiercely determined to seek vengeance and unmask the true perpetrator.

name: Celtics City
summary: Celtics City chronicles the history, cultural impact, and extraordinary tale of the NBA's winningest and most storied franchise, the Boston Celtics, the current 2024 NBA Champion. The series contains extensive, never-before-seen archives and more than 80 interviews of past and present Boston Celtics legends – from Bob Cousy and Larry Bird to Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown.

name: Ms. Nirvana
summary: After the Fu family's massacre, only the daughter, Fu Zhaoxue survives, but the evidence points to her former lover, Gu Jingzhou. Returning with a new face as Lin Qianyu, she marries into the Gu family to uncover their secrets, reigniting a forbidden romance with Gu Jingzhou. As truths unfold, love and old grudges resurface, leading to an intense rekindling of feelings.

name: Foundations of the West
summary: Explore ancient Western cities with Dr. Jordan Peterson & experts in a 5-part series, uncovering their impact on the modern world.

name: Love Endless Eternally
summary: Time traveler Chi Yuan thought it was just a sweet love mission, only to find herself entangled in Shen Zhaomu's revenge plan! To fulfill both 'love' and 'revenge' missions, they face storms of blood and tears, life and death twists, and ultimately find true love!

name: Со всеми бывает
summary: Invited experts dispel common stereotypes and talk about modern methods of treatment and prevention of exacerbations of mental illnesses. The heroes share the attitude of those around them - relatives, friends, society - to their diagnosis, and talk about how they managed to adapt, what difficulties they overcome daily and their plans for further combating the disease.

name: The Secret Lives of Animals
summary: The Secret Lives of Animals highlights 77 unique species in 24 countries over three years, revealing stunning, never-before-seen animal behaviors and highlighting the remarkable intelligence of the natural world.

name: Oro jaska
summary: Elli Anne wakes up with bruises after a party, while Issát fears his secret could ruin everything. Rumors swirl, and the silence must be broken.

name: Cold Cases Reopened
summary: Series following detectives investigating cases that remained unsolved for years and decades, and the stories of how they delivered long-overdue justice.

name: Il était une fois dans le trouble
Pee-wee as Himself
summary: Driven by a soul-baring interview with Paul Reubens, the man behind the iconic character Pee-wee Herman, Pee-wee as Himself is the definitive portrait of the comedic performer, and a window into his never before discussed personal life. Determined to correct the record and tell the factual story of his life, Reubens excavates his kaleidoscopic influences, origins in the circus and avant-garde performance theater, and career choices, while reflecting on the reasoning behind, and the consequences of, severing his beloved alter ego from his authentic self.

name: The Road
summary: The Road offers viewers a backstage pass into the gritty and unforgiving life of a touring artist. With exclusive access to the behind-the-scenes workings of the music industry, viewers will see what happens when some of the best up-and-coming performers pile into a tour bus and tackle a grueling schedule in pursuit of their dreams.

name: Amsterdam Empire
summary:
Jack van Doorn, the rich and notorious founder of the coffee shop empire Jackal, has had to fight his entire career against criminals, competitors, and absurd Dutch laws to become the biggest of them all. When his affair with a well-known journalist comes to light, it turns out that his most dangerous enemy has been living under his roof all this time: his betrayed wife, Betty, an ex-pop diva who knows all his weak spots and secrets and will not rest until she has taken everything from him. 

Amsterdam Empire is an extravagant crime drama full of glamour and grime at the heart of the Amsterdam cannabis scene.

name: Hein
summary: Hein, an eleven-year-old boy, is captivated by his grandfather's unconventional job – caring for a cemetery. When Hein spends his summer at the graveyard, he discovers he has supernatural powers to speak to the spirits. He is not afraid when he is befriended by the spirits to help them wrap up unfinished dealings in the world. It becomes his mission to bring guidance and messages to the spirits and their loved ones, while learning about the power of compassion and living our lives the best way we can.

previousepisode.name: De mooiste dag van je leven

name: PAWsome Puzzles
summary: Help the PAW Patrol solve games, puzzles, and brainteasers in these mini-missions.

name: Nova Cena
summary: To wear the rap crown, you'll need to rule the stage. Brazilian rappers face off in this competition featuring Djonga, Filipe Ret, Tasha and Tracie.

name: Legal Boy
summary: A sudden stroke of fortune changes everything! Migrant worker Li Gouwa steps into the world of the wealthy, not for riches, but to seek justice for his brother. However, what he stumbles upon is a carefully planned murder. His arrival ignites a fierce inheritance battle within Dongcan Group, where the three Zhang brothers scheme and fight for control. Playing the fool while hiding his true strength, Li Gouwa dives deep into a whirlpool of conspiracies. Facing ruthless opponents, he survives against all odds, turning the tables time and again. In the end, driven by justice, he topples the elite and breaks free from the deadly trap.

name: Наваждение
summary: The morning after the wedding, Dina wakes up and realizes that she doesn't know her husband. Moreover, she doesn't remember the events of the last year at all! Relatives and doctors calm the girl down, attributing everything to severe stress. Meanwhile, Dina decides to figure everything out herself.
